name: Hotel Casa San Agustin
positioning: Boutique hotel of three colonial houses in Cartagena's historic center, with the Aurum Spa and a private beach on the island of Baru
best_for: Travelers who want colonial character in Cartagena's historic center
Couples looking for spa rituals and a private beach escape

facts.text: The hotel occupies three whitewashed colonial buildings in Cartagena's historic center.
The hotel is on Calle de la Universidad in Cartagena.
The interiors feature wooden-beamed ceilings and wall frescos.
The hotel's traditional decoration tells the story of its 17th-century beginnings.
Stays come with outdoor spaces, luxurious linens and hand-picked amenities.
Aurum Spa takes its name from the Latin word for gold.
The spa's Time is Gold ritual coats the body in a golden emulsion after a Hammam exfoliation, ending with a facial and body massage.
The spa offers a Cartagena coffee body scrub.
A couples ritual at the spa begins with a soak in the jacuzzi.
Alma Restaurant's dishes echo the flavors and colors of Cartagena.

highlights.text: Casa San Agustin is a boutique hotel made of three houses inspired by Cartagena's colonial heritage.
Acasi Beach is the hotel's private beach on the island of Baru.
The Aurum Spa's Hammam ritual uses a scrub made of coffee, volcanic mud and pure tobacco after a steam room cleanse.
At Acasi Beach, guests can stay in rustic beach bungalows overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

considerations.text: Acasi Beach is one hour from Cartagena, so the beach is a separate outing rather than at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that room sizes tend to be smaller, typical of colonial architecture.
